purpose: Show the observed same-scope resource contrasts without treating unfinished work as full-workflow consumption or combining prospectively separate cohorts.

panels.x: budgetWorkBytes in MiB, logarithmic base two
panels.marker: independently observed complete workflow or causal terminal resource failure

rules: No jitter, guessed outcomes, interpolated missing cases or confidence intervals.
Show the actual sampled peak for terminal failures; explicitly state that this is incomplete work and not the required total storage.
Display unknown and not-observed denominators in each panel.
Plot quota equality and observed production estimates as separately labeled lines.
State that software/shared container infrastructure and experiment-only root telemetry are outside the assigned work-storage scope.
Preserve original forty and separately frozen six boundary contrasts, with one development protein and no biological metric substitution.
Export PNG at 300 DPI plus vector PDF and SVG; use colorblind-friendly blue/orange with distinct shape encoding and readable Spanish labels.
